title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2016 英语一 Part B 小标题匹配 · 2026-11-06纸质真题复盘 · 本篇问题 4 题 + 历史弱项 4 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本轮结果被GitHub接收并经Actions核验后，才会进入后续间隔复习；未提交的浏览器作答只保存在本地。

questions.skill: 段落功能：先判断是否需要行动
questions.q: A regional council has discussed replacing a bridge. Before ordering materials, engineers recommend checking recent traffic counts, the condition of the existing structure and whether repairs could suffice. Several members argue that a new bridge may not be necessary. Which heading best captures this paragraph?
o: Celebrate the benefits of a new bridge
Increase the bridge construction budget
Decide whether replacement is justified
Ask local businesses to donate materials

exp.trans: 地区议会考虑更换桥梁，但工程师要求先核验交通量、现有桥况及修复可能性，有人认为未必需要重建。
exp.structure: Before ordering materials以及may not be necessary共同说明段落中心是判断行动必要性。
exp.other: suffice足够；justify证明合理；structure建筑结构。
exp.meaning: 选择标题需要提取段落承担的功能：是否应该启动工程，而不是泛泛鼓励行动。
exp.rest: 庆祝新桥、增加预算和募捐都不是这段讨论的主要任务。

questions.target: paragraph core goal vs illustrative measure
questions.skill: 主旨判断：整体任务与具体例子
questions.q: A neighbourhood group first surveyed why families rarely used a public park. It found poor lighting, inaccessible entrances and a lack of seating. The group then proposed fixing those barriers and measuring whether more residents return, rather than simply holding one publicity event. What heading captures the main point?
o: A Guide to Advertising One Weekend Event
Why Park Volunteers Need More Members
Remove Barriers to Everyday Park Use
The History of Street Lighting Projects

exp.trans: 社区调查公园少有人使用的原因，发现照明、入口和座椅问题，建议解决这些障碍并评估使用效果。
exp.structure: surveyed why... 和 fixing those barriers指向找原因并改善可用性；宣传活动只是对照。
exp.other: inaccessible难进入的；barrier障碍；usable可使用的。
exp.meaning: 标题应覆盖对使用障碍的调查和改善，而不是抽一个局部措施当作全篇主旨。
exp.rest: 单次活动广告、招募人数、照明史均不是本段总体论点。

questions.skill: 跨段分配：启动条件与高效执行
questions.q: Two parts describe an emergency radio system. I: The city will activate emergency broadcasting only when official flood measurements pass a defined threshold; a rehearsal alone does not justify activation. II: Operators replace several separate login steps with one verified dashboard, reducing the time needed to send approved alerts. Select the best headings.
o: I: Remove login steps; II: Set flood thresholds
I: Extend the rehearsal; II: Increase water levels
I: Send all alerts now; II: Review past floods
I: Check alert thresholds; II: Speed up dispatch

exp.trans: 第一段设置水位超过阈值才启动广播；第二段用统一控制台简化已批准警报的发送步骤。
exp.structure: only when限定启动条件；replace several steps和reducing time指向执行效率。
exp.other: threshold阈值；dashboard控制台；dispatch发送/调度。
exp.meaning: 触发条件属于when，操作步骤缩短属于how；即使两段都有时间线索也不能互换。
exp.rest: 换位、延长彩排、提高水位和立即发布都与原文机制不同。

questions.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
questions.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
questions.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

questions.skill: 识别with复合结构的伴随状态
questions.q: The archive reopened at noon, with several boxes waiting in the loading area. What does the with-clause do?
o: It describes a state accompanying the archive's reopening.
It gives the sole reason the archive reopened at noon.
It reports an action that archive staff carried out.
It is the direct object of reopened in the main clause.

exp.trans: 档案馆中午重新开放，当时有几个箱子正等在装卸区。with结构补充了重新开放时伴随的状态。
exp.structure: 主干是The archive reopened at noon；with several boxes waiting in the loading area是with + 名词 + 现在分词结构，several boxes是waiting的逻辑主语。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；reopen 重新开放；loading area 装卸区；accompany 伴随。
exp.meaning: with复合结构常补充主句发生时的伴随状态。它不是reopened的直接宾语，也不自动表达原因或目的。
exp.rest: 句子没有说明这是档案馆重新开放的唯一原因；with短语描述箱子所处的状态，并未说工作人员另做了一项动作；reopened在这里是不及物动词，不需要直接宾语。

questions.q: During a field inspection, a technician fastened a thin cord around the sensor housing by making a knot. The team then handed a calibration weight from one person to the next. Which pair describes the actions?
o: wrapped the cord / carried the weight
tied the cord / passed the weight
passed the cord / tied the weight
lit the cord / wrapped the weight

exp.trans: 现场检查时，技术员打结把细绳系在传感器外壳上；随后团队成员把校准砝码从一人手中传到下一人手中。对应动作是tie和pass。
exp.structure: 第一句technician fastened...by making a knot，by短语明确系绳方式是打结；第二句the team handed...from one person to the next，明确物体在人与人之间转交。
exp.other: field inspection现场检查；sensor housing传感器外壳；calibration weight校准砝码；knot结。
exp.meaning: tie表示系住、打结；pass something from one person to the next表示把东西传递给下一个人。要识别动作的结果和路径。
exp.rest: wrap表示包裹或缠绕，未必形成固定的结；carry表示携带而非交到下一人手中；pass the cord / tie the weight把两个动作对象对调；light和wrap都不符合句中动作。

questions.target: executive enforcement choice vs statutory local authority
questions.skill: 行政不执行是否能取消地方依法获授的权力
questions.q: A national agency declined to inspect licensed buses, then claimed towns could not carry out inspections that a statute authorized them to do. The court rejected the claim. What principle does its decision illustrate?
o: The agency may suspend towns' lawful inspections by choosing not to act.
The court rejected an attempt to block towns from exercising powers granted by law.
The towns were newly authorized to rewrite national transport standards.
The court found that national agencies alone may set all inspection dates.

exp.trans: 国家行政机构不愿检查已获许可的公交车，随后却声称法律已授权的市镇检查也不能执行。法院驳回该主张，说明行政机关自身选择不执法，不能自动取消地方依法获授的权限。
exp.structure: declined... then claimed...区分行政机关自身行为与扩张主张；a statute authorized them to do修饰inspections；The court rejected the claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: agency 行政机构；statute 成文法；authorize 授权；suspend 暂停；licensed bus 已获许可的公交车辆。
exp.meaning: 行政机关不执行某项政策与禁止地方执行是两个命题。这里法院限制的是行政部门把其执行偏好扩展成否定地方合法权限的企图。
exp.rest: 行政不作为并未赋予机构暂停合法地方执法的权力；法院未授权市镇重写国家标准；设定检查日期也不是法院本次驳回的争点。

questions.skill: 职业词与观察社会规范
questions.q: A factory hired an anthropologist to observe how workers exchange informal advice and follow unwritten rules. What expertise did the factory seek?
o: Experience designing industrial steel machinery
Training in treating occupational injuries
Skills for calculating tax on equipment
Knowledge of group behaviour and shared customs

exp.trans: 工厂聘请人类学家观察工人如何交流非正式建议、遵守不成文规则，关注群体文化。
exp.structure: observe how...列出研究对象；unwritten rules指非正式社会规范。
exp.other: anthropologist人类学家；custom习俗；unwritten不成文的。
exp.meaning: anthropologist研究人类及其文化社会行为，不等于技术设备专家。
exp.rest: 机器设计、工伤治疗和税务计算不对应非正式群体规则研究。

heading-core-function.target: when to act vs confident publicity
heading-core-function.q: A wildlife centre has finished breeding rare frogs, but releasing them immediately could be dangerous. Staff must first check pond temperatures, rainfall and predator activity. If the conditions remain unsuitable, the release will be postponed. Which heading fits best?
o: Choose suitable conditions for the release
Publicize the centre's achievements widely
Expand the size of the breeding programme
Recruit new volunteers to care for the frogs

exp.trans: 保护中心完成蛙类繁育，但放归前必须检查水温、降雨和捕食者活动；条件不合适便推迟。
exp.structure: must first check和If... postponed标明主要动作是决定合适放归时机。
exp.other: predator捕食者；release放归；suitable适宜的。
exp.meaning: 段落不是表现信心或庆祝成果，而是围绕何时执行放归的判断。
exp.rest: 宣传、扩充育种和招募志愿者没有对应段落的判断功能。

heading-core-function.skill: 段落功能：先确定更新是否有必要
heading-core-function.q: A library is considering buying expensive digital cataloguing software. The librarian advises measuring how often the current system fails and asking readers which problems actually interfere with their searches. If these problems are rare, keeping the existing system may be wiser. Which heading is most suitable?
o: Replace the software without any further review
Explain the history of digital library systems
Promote the new software to every local school
Establish whether a costly change is needed

exp.trans: 图书馆考虑购入昂贵目录软件，但建议先调查旧系统故障是否真实严重，否则保留现状更合理。
exp.structure: considering与If ... rare限定论述为决策前评估，而非立即采购。
exp.other: cataloguing编目；interfere with妨碍；wiser更明智。
exp.meaning: 中心是评价升级必要性，个别数字化词汇不是立即换系统的证据。
exp.rest: 不审查直接更换、讲历史和向学校推广都与原文目标不符。

title-coverage.target: 标题覆盖全文 / 局部主题
title-coverage.q: 短文先介绍图书馆除纸质借阅外的电子书、设备借用和线上课程，随后重点讨论线上课程的版权风险。哪个标题最能覆盖全文？
o: Copyright Problems in Online Courses
Beyond Printed Books: New Library Services
Why E-books Will Replace Libraries
The Only Safe Way to Teach Online

exp.trans: 文章先介绍图书馆在纸质书借阅之外提供的多种新服务，后文再重点讨论其中线上课程的版权风险。最合适的标题应覆盖多种新服务这一全文框架，而不是只概括后半部分。
exp.structure: 题干给出总框架到其中一项风险的篇章结构。标题需要同时解释前半部分为什么介绍多个服务，也能容纳后半部分的版权讨论。
exp.other: printed book 纸质书；device lending 设备借用；copyright 版权；cover 覆盖。
exp.meaning: 标题题要找能统摄全文的上位概念。局部篇幅很长，也不能因此把局部主题当成全文主题。
exp.rest: Copyright Problems in Online Courses只覆盖后半篇；Why E-books Will Replace Libraries加入取代主张；The Only Safe Way含Only且主题过窄。

title-coverage.target: 标题 / 全文发展主线
title-coverage.q: 短文追踪社区公共厨房如何从临时救灾供餐点转为日常共享备餐场所；中段介绍管理规则的变化，末段采访新加入的常住居民。哪个标题覆盖全文主线？
o: Who Uses Community Kitchens Today
From Emergency Meals to Shared Cooking
Rules for Running a Disaster Kitchen
Why Shared Kitchens Need New Buildings

exp.trans: 全文追踪公共厨房从灾时供餐到日常共享备餐的转变。From Emergency Meals to Shared Cooking意为“从应急供餐到共享烹饪”；其他标题分别聚焦当下使用者、灾时管理、未提到的新建筑需求。
exp.structure: 叙述按功能转变组织；规则变化和居民采访都是这一演变的证据。标题中的from...to...覆盖起点、终点及中间变化，而不仅是末段人物。
exp.other: emergency meal 应急供餐；shared cooking 共享烹饪；resident 常住居民；disaster 灾害。
exp.meaning: 全文覆盖可以体现时间或功能发展的主线，不必总列出多个并行服务。结尾采访显眼，但不应代替文章的发展轴。
exp.rest: Who Uses...只覆盖末段使用者；Rules for Running...只覆盖原有救灾角色的管理部分，漏掉转变；New Buildings引入未论述的建设需求。

title-coverage.target: 标题 / 比较框架与局部例证
title-coverage.q: 短文比较潮汐发电、屋顶太阳能、废热回收在沿海城市中的成本、时间限制与扩展条件。末段详细讨论废热管网维护，作为能源方案受当地条件影响的例子。哪个标题最好？
o: Maintaining Urban Heating Pipes
The Limits of Tidal Generation
Replacing Solar Panels with Recovered Heat
Energy Choices Shaped by Local Conditions

exp.trans: 文章比较三类能源方案的成本、可用时段与扩展条件，并用废热管网维护作例证。Energy Choices Shaped by Local Conditions是“由当地条件塑造的能源选择”。
exp.structure: 全文是多方案比较框架；末段维护细节从属于共同约束。标题中shaped by local conditions是修饰Energy Choices的过去分词短语，突出共同决定因素。
exp.other: tidal generation 潮汐发电；solar panel 太阳能板；recovered heat 回收热量；local condition 当地条件。
exp.meaning: 标题要覆盖比较对象及比较所得的共同轴线。篇幅较长的末段案例不等于全文唯一对象。
exp.rest: Maintaining...缩成末段管网维护；Limits of Tidal...只剩一种发电方式；Replacing Solar...虚构“以废热替代太阳能”的取舍结论，原文只说比较与条件约束。

title-coverage.target: 多阶段主题覆盖 / 防止只抓矛盾
title-coverage.q: A town once treated residents' road-hazard reports as isolated messages. It later built a system in which local volunteers gather reports, engineers check them, and officials publish verified travel advice. Advice is corrected when new evidence arrives. The town says repeated checking and revision—not merely the first report—has made the system dependable. Which title best covers the passage?
o: Why Local Volunteers Sometimes Make Mistakes
The Threat of False Reports at the Start of Every Journey
How Road-Hazard Reports Become Trusted Public Advice
A Debate over Whether Engineers Should Be Replaced

exp.trans: 小镇从最初零散的道路危险报告，发展到志愿者收集、工程师核查、官方发布，并根据新证据修订建议的流程。全文重点是信息如何逐步成为可靠的公共建议。
exp.structure: once ... later ... when ... 的时间和条件连接展开过程；最后一句not merely the first report强调可信度来自持续核查与修订。
exp.other: hazard 危险；isolated 零散的；verified 核实过的；dependable 可靠的。
exp.meaning: 标题需要覆盖‘初始信息→验证→公开→更新→可信’整条主线。仅强调最初的错误或一次争论，都只覆盖局部或无证据。
exp.rest: 志愿者犯错只是潜在局部问题；旅途中的虚假报告不是全文核心；替换工程师与原文分工核查相反。

title-coverage.target: 标题跨段覆盖 / 不凭字母分布
title-coverage.skill: 选择覆盖发展主线的标题
title-coverage.q: A school district began by collecting students' complaints about lunch menus. Nutrition staff then tested alternative recipes, while parents and kitchen workers assessed cost and acceptance. Several proposals were changed after trials. The district now repeats the evaluation each year rather than treating its first reform as final. Which is the best title?
o: The Hidden Cost of Hiring School Kitchen Workers
From Lunch Complaints to an Evolving Food Program
Why Students Reject Every Healthy Menu
A Final Recipe That Ended School Food Debates

exp.trans: 学区从收集学生对午餐菜单的意见出发，经过营养人员测试、家长和食堂人员评估、试行后修改，并每年继续复评。主线是餐食方案逐步形成并不断演进。
exp.structure: began by ... then ... after trials ... now ... each year组成完整发展顺序；rather than treating ... as final明确不是一次定案。
exp.other: nutrition staff 营养工作人员；alternative recipe 替代食谱；assess 评估；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 最佳标题应包含问题提出、集体检验和持续改进。不能因为某个字母此前少出现，就放弃更能覆盖全文的选项。
exp.rest: 雇员成本只是局部评估维度；every healthy menu属于无依据的绝对化；final recipe与每年重新评估矛盾。

title-coverage.target: 标题覆盖 / 核心事件
title-coverage.skill: 核心行动与话题相关性辨析
title-coverage.q: A city bus operator is testing overnight bicycle parking at three depots. The article explains how the trial works, cyclists' responses, and staffing limits. Nearby repair shops appear only as background. Which title best captures the article's central event?
o: Cyclists Turn to Bus Drivers for Help with Bike Repairs
City Bus Depots Host an Overnight Cycle-Parking Trial
Bicycles Become Part of the City's Transport Mix
Every Bus Depot Opens Permanently for Cycle Storage

exp.trans: 城市公交运营方正在三个车场试行夜间自行车停车服务。文章介绍试行办法、骑车者反应和人员限制，附近修车店只是背景。标题应概括公交车场试行夜间自行车停车这一事件。
exp.structure: 首句主语A city bus operator，谓语is testing，宾语overnight bicycle parking；at three depots限定试点范围。后两句区分围绕试行的主体内容与仅作背景的修车店。
exp.other: operator运营方；depot车场；overnight过夜的；staffing人员配备。
exp.meaning: 标题要保留核心主体、行动及试行性质，并能统领实施、反应和限制。仅与自行车或交通话题相关，不足以概括文章。
exp.rest: “公交司机帮忙修车”把背景改成主要行动；“自行车进入城市交通组合”虽话题相关，却遗漏夜间停车试行；“所有车场永久开放”同时扩大three和testing的范围、确定性。

title-coverage.target: 主旨标题 / 行动与原因
title-coverage.skill: 概括全文发展而非抓相关词
title-coverage.q: Local bookshops are replacing separate next-day deliveries with a slower shared service. The article explains rising van costs, pooled routes, and customers accepting longer waits for lower delivery charges. A brief section about authors' visits supplies background. Which title best captures the main development?
o: Online Shopping Reshapes Relations with Local Shops
Local Bookshops Abandon Online Orders and Deliveries
Book Launches Become the Main Job of Delivery Teams
Bookshops Pool Deliveries to Lower Transport Costs

exp.trans: 当地书店正用速度稍慢的共享配送取代各店分别进行的次日配送。文章分析货车成本上涨、合并线路以及顾客接受较长等待来换取较低配送费；作家来访只是背景。主线是书店通过合并配送降低运输成本。
exp.structure: 首句主语Local bookshops，谓语are replacing，宾语separate next-day deliveries，with引出替代方案。第二句explains后列举改革原因、运作方式及顾客反应；最后一句明示作家活动只是背景。
exp.other: pooled routes合并安排的线路；van厢式货车；delivery charge配送费；background背景。
exp.meaning: 一个标题若能同时统领成本原因、共享做法和顾客取舍，比只罗列相关话题更准确。概括不能把改用另一种配送扩大为停止线上业务。
exp.rest: “网购改变与商店的关系”相关但过于宽泛，遗漏合并配送降成本的核心变化；“放弃网购订单和配送”与仍有shared service矛盾；“送货团队主要举办新书活动”把背景细节升级成主旨，并加入无依据的团队职责。

title-coverage.target: title coverage / 核心争议对象
title-coverage.q: At a university, hiring panels have long treated publication counts and institutional prestige as the main signs of academic merit. A new proposal gives more weight to teaching, mentoring and contributions to local research groups. Critics argue that the old measures overlook important work, especially by early-career scholars. Which title best captures the central issue?
o: A Challenge to Universities' Ideas of Academic Merit
Another Debate About Competition in Higher Education
Why Young Scholars Are Leaving University Research
A New Ranking System for Research Universities

exp.trans: 大学招聘长期把论文数量和机构声望当作学术价值的主要标志。新方案提高教学、指导学生和本地研究贡献的权重，批评者认为旧标准忽略重要工作。核心是挑战大学对学术价值的既有定义。
exp.structure: 首句交代既有评价标准；第二句提出新方案；第三句由Critics argue引出中心批评。
exp.other: publication count论文数量；institutional prestige机构声望；academic merit学术价值；early-career scholar职业早期学者。
exp.meaning: 正确标题同时覆盖被挑战的主体（大学）和争议对象（学术价值标准），而不是只摘取一个局部案例。
exp.rest: 有的选项只说高等教育竞争，范围过宽；有的声称年轻学者正在离开研究岗位，原文没有此事实；还有的把新评价方案误写成已经建立的新排名系统。

title-coverage.q: A city library has been judged mainly by the number of books borrowed. A new review argues that this measure misses digital help, language classes, and access for residents who cannot visit during the day. It asks the city to reconsider what a successful library provides. Which title best represents the argument?
o: Rethinking How Cities Measure Library Success
Why Borrowing Books Has Declined in City Libraries
A Plan to Replace Libraries with Online Services
The Growing Cost of Running Public Libraries

exp.trans: 一座城市图书馆过去主要按借阅量评价。新评估指出，这一指标忽略数字服务、语言课程以及白天无法到馆居民的使用机会，因而要求重新思考什么才算图书馆成功。
exp.structure: 首句给出旧指标；第二句指出其遗漏；第三句概括中心诉求。
exp.other: borrow借阅；digital help数字服务；access使用机会/可及性；measure衡量指标。
exp.meaning: 核心不是借阅量下降、线上服务取代图书馆或运营成本，而是成功标准需要重新衡量。
exp.rest: 借阅量下降并未被报告；用线上服务取代图书馆超出原文；把成本当成核心问题也偏离文章。

title-coverage.q: A city tested reflective roofs to reduce summer heat. The report says roofs helped, but shaded bus stops, drinking-water access and support for elderly residents must also be included in a wider plan. Which title best captures the point?
o: How Reflective Roofs Became the City's Only Heat Tool
Why Elderly Residents Have Stopped Using Public Buses
The Falling Price of Roof Materials in Urban Markets
Citywide Heat Planning Beyond Reflective Roofs Alone

exp.trans: 反光屋顶有用，但高温应对还需遮阴、饮水和老人支持。
exp.structure: but把主旨从单项措施引向综合方案。
exp.other: reflective反光的；shade遮阴；response应对。
exp.meaning: 标题要涵盖由局部措施向综合应对转变的论点。
exp.rest: 唯一措施、老人停止公交和材料降价均偏离原文。

title-coverage.q: An online learning platform recommends courses using past clicks. Researchers say this may help discovery, but ask for clearer explanations and a way for students to override the system. Which title fits best?
o: Why Online Courses Should Be Abolished for Everyone
Making Course Suggestions Clearer and Easier to Control
The Complete History of University Enrollment Systems
How Student Click Data Has Become Entirely Useless

exp.trans: 研究者认可基于点击的推荐有一定用途，但要求透明解释和学生自主改选。
exp.structure: may help discovery肯定实用性；but ask for指出核心改进诉求。
exp.other: recommend推荐；override人工覆盖；transparent透明的。
exp.meaning: 标题应强调推荐系统更透明和可控，而非全面放弃线上课程。
exp.rest: 废除课程、招生历史和点击数据全无用均不是论点。

title-coverage.skill: 方法论中心而非局部例子
title-coverage.q: Cafeterias have traditionally counted leftover food only by weight. A study finds that this hides differences between discarded meals, preparation scraps and food safely donated. It recommends separate measures for each. Which title best reflects the study?
o: Why Students Always Leave Food on Their Plates
The Cost of Replacing All School Kitchen Equipment
Measuring Food Waste More Precisely Across Its Sources
A Call to Stop Donating Leftover Food to Local Groups

exp.trans: 报告认为只按重量统计食物浪费不够，应分别衡量餐食、备菜边角和捐赠。
exp.structure: traditionally交代旧法，It recommends呈现主要主张。
exp.other: cafeteria食堂；scraps边角料；discard丢弃。
exp.meaning: 标题需要涵盖衡量方法的改进和分类原则。
exp.rest: 学生总剩饭、替换所有设备或停止捐赠都无证据。

title-coverage.skill: 识别转折后的核心议题
title-coverage.q: A charity celebrates a rise in volunteer sign-ups. Its annual review notes, however, that most newcomers leave within a month and argues for mentoring and flexible shifts. Which title best captures its concern?
o: From Volunteer Recruitment to Keeping Volunteers Engaged
The End of Volunteer Work in Modern Communities
Why Charities Have Stopped Recruiting New Workers
An Unprecedented Surge in Long-Term Volunteer Loyalty

exp.trans: 志愿者招募增多，但新人很快退出；报告要求导师指导与灵活排班。
exp.structure: however将主题从招募成绩转移到留存问题。
exp.other: sign-up报名；mentoring指导；retention留存。
exp.meaning: 标题应概括招募和留存之间的落差与解决方向。
exp.rest: 终结志愿服务、停止招募、长期忠诚度增加均不真实。

heading-global-allocation.target: two paragraphs share time but have different jobs
heading-global-allocation.skill: 跨段分配：时机评估与流程简化
heading-global-allocation.q: Read both passages before assigning headings. I: A geology team wants to visit an unstable slope. Before travelling, its leader checks weather warnings and whether the slope has settled enough for safe access. The team will wait if necessary. II: During fieldwork, staff waste time writing the same labels on every sample bag. A printed label sheet and standard kit now remove most of these repeated choices. Which pairing fits?
o: I: Save fieldwork time; II: Assess trip safety
I: Check departure readiness; II: Simplify labelling
I: Expand field staff; II: Improve forecasts
I: Buy better samples; II: Start earlier

exp.trans: 第一段检查危险坡面是否适合现在出发；第二段通过预印标签与标准工具包减少重复选择。
exp.structure: I的Before travelling与wait指向出行决策；II的repeated choices和printed label指向效率。
exp.other: unstable不稳定的；slope坡面；fieldwork野外作业。
exp.meaning: 同一组文章涉及时间，但标题应按每段的目标分配：时机合适与减少操作成本不是一回事。
exp.rest: 省时不能代替安全判断；扩员、买样品、提前出发都不是两段实际建议。

heading-global-allocation.skill: 跨段分配：何时开诊与怎样减负
heading-global-allocation.q: Match the two sections. I: A mobile health clinic is ready to serve remote villages, but the doctors will not begin visits until medicines arrive and local referral routes are confirmed. II: Once services begin, nurses use prepacked supply boxes and a short standard form so they spend less time making routine decisions. Which allocation is accurate?
o: I: Cut paperwork; II: Choose the launch date
I: Set the launch conditions; II: Streamline routine work
I: Recruit more doctors; II: Expand village roads
I: Shorten each visit; II: Verify drug deliveries

exp.trans: 移动诊所第一段讲药物和转诊路线确定后才能启动；第二段讲使用预装箱和表单减轻日常负担。
exp.structure: until medicines arrive是开诊前提；Once services begin进入日常工作阶段。
exp.other: referral转诊；prepacked预先装好的；routine例行的。
exp.meaning: 先建立两段独立的功能标签，再分配标题；不能因为第二段出现time就挪用第一段的时机标题。
exp.rest: 错配标题或加入招募、修路、缩短每次诊疗等未讨论内容都不成立。

heading-global-allocation.target: readiness check vs fewer repeated choices
heading-global-allocation.skill: 跨段分配：确认条件与降低决策疲劳
heading-global-allocation.q: Read both sections. I: A vaccine programme can start in mountain towns only after refrigerators have passed temperature tests and transport routes are confirmed. Until then, managers must delay delivery. II: Warehouse teams reduce repeated packing decisions by using a fixed checklist and ready-made supply sets; each order now takes less time. Choose the right assignment.
o: I: Check start-up conditions; II: Make packing efficient
I: Cut packing work; II: Check cold-storage readiness
I: Explain vaccine science; II: Extend delivery routes
I: Begin delivery immediately; II: Add more approvals

exp.trans: 第一段讲冷链与运输路线未确认前不得开始；第二段通过固定清单和预配套件减少重复打包决策。
exp.structure: only after与Until then是必要条件与等待；fixed checklist说明执行流程优化。
exp.other: cold chain冷链；ready-made预配好的；approval批准。
exp.meaning: 第一段回答何时能启动，第二段回答如何减少重复选择，两者不可因出现time而混淆。
exp.rest: 互换标题、讲疫苗原理、立即运送和增加审批都偏离两段核心。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。

with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.q:
The bakery opened at six, with warm bread cooling on the counter.
with 后面的结构主要起什么作用？
o: 补充开门时伴随的状态
引出老板的直接引语
说明开门的唯一目的
充当opened的直接宾语

exp.trans: 面包店六点开门，当时温热的面包正在柜台上晾凉。
exp.structure: 主干：The bakery（主语）+ opened（不及物谓语）+ at six（时间状语）。原始简单句Warm bread was cooling on the counter → 去掉was，用with引出：with warm bread cooling on the counter。warm bread是with结构的逻辑主语，cooling是与之构成主动关系的现在分词。
exp.other: bakery 面包店；cool 晾凉、变凉；counter 柜台；warm 温热的。
exp.meaning: with复合结构可以补充主句发生时的伴随状态；它不是新的独立主句。
exp.rest: 直接引语通常由say等动词引出，此处没有任何说话行为。目的常用to do或in order to，原句只描写伴随状态。opened在本句是不及物用法，with短语不是其直接宾语。

with.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
with.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

action-collocation.skill: 包裹与打结的动作区别
action-collocation.q: Before shipping a glass instrument, a clerk covered it with protective cloth, folding the cloth around the case in several layers. No knot or fastening was used. Which paraphrase best describes the action?
o: wrapped the case in protective cloth
tied the cloth tightly around the case
passed the cloth to a colleague nearby
lit the cloth with a match

exp.trans: 发运玻璃仪器前，工作人员用防护布包住仪器，把布一层层折叠在外壳周围；没有打结或固定。动作是包裹。
exp.structure: a clerk covered it...是主干；folding the cloth around the case补充包裹方式；No knot or fastening was used排除了打结固定。
exp.other: protective cloth防护布；case外壳；layer层；fastening固定件/固定动作。
exp.meaning: wrap强调用材料包住或缠绕物体；tie强调用绳带系住，常包含打结或固定。此处布料覆盖并折叠，没有系结。
exp.rest: tie要求系住/固定的动作，题干明确说没有knot或fastening；pass表示传递；light表示点燃，均不符合包裹仪器的场景。

action-collocation.q: At a camp safety drill, one camper handed a lantern from the first person to the last; another lit a stove after the group had settled. Which pair describes the actions?
o: lit the lantern / passed the stove
passed the lantern / lit the stove
wrapped the lantern / tied the stove
tied the lantern / wrapped the stove

exp.trans: 营地安全演练中，一名露营者把灯笼从队伍第一个人传到最后一个人；另一人等大家安顿后点燃了炉子。动作分别是传递灯笼和点燃炉子。
exp.structure: one camper handed a lantern...是第一项动作；from the first person to the last给出传递路径。another lit a stove是第二项动作，after从句说明时间。
exp.other: camp safety drill营地安全演练；lantern灯笼；stove炉子；settle安顿下来。
exp.meaning: pass表示把物品从一个人交给另一个人；light表示点燃。要把动词与其实际宾语及动作路径配对。
exp.rest: 把lit和passed的对象对调；wrap和tie表示包裹/系绑，不符合手递手传灯笼或点燃炉子的动作。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的权力主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency says it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever the rule conflicts with its enforcement priorities. What does that claim imply?
o: It claims its enforcement power outweighs regional governments' authority.
Regional governments may override national laws whenever they disagree.
The legislature expressly banned all regional enforcement activity.
The agency accepts regional rules despite differences in enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要原本合法的地区规则与其执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称行政机构的执法权高于地区政府的权限。
exp.structure: An executive agency says that...引出机构的主张；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: executive agency 行政机构；invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；authority 权限。
exp.meaning: 题目问what does that claim imply，应概括机构声称自己拥有多大权限，而不是把这一主张误当成作者认可的法律结论。
exp.rest: 地区政府可以随意推翻国家法律是把权力方向反过来；立法机关明文禁止所有地区执法并未在句中出现；最后一项与机构声称可使冲突规则失效相反。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 作者立场 + do so 回指
text4-executive-overreach.q: A transport ministry says that because it does not want to carry out Parliament's rail-safety plan, local councils should not be allowed to enforce it either. The court rejects this claim. What is best supported?
o: The court checks an executive attempt to extend power over local councils.
Parliament alone must enforce every rail-safety rule across all regions.
The ministry has unlimited control over local councils and their rules.
Local councils may ignore national rail-safety laws whenever they choose to do so.

exp.trans: 法院正在制衡行政部门试图扩大自身对地方议会的权力。
exp.structure: because引出交通部不愿执行议会计划的原因；should not be allowed...either表示它还想阻止地方执行；The court rejects this claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: carry out 执行；executive 行政部门；council 地方议会；reject a claim 驳回一种主张。
exp.meaning: 行政部门不愿执行议会的计划，不等于它可以阻止地方在法律允许范围内执行。法院驳回这种主张，体现对行政权的制衡。
exp.rest: 原文没有说所有铁路安全规则只能由议会执行；交通部并没有无限控制权；法院驳回行政部门的主张也不意味着地方可以无视所有国家法律。

text4-executive-overreach.target: claim about enforcement power vs legal authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency claims it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever that rule conflicts with the agency's enforcement priorities. What does the agency's claim amount to?
o: Regional governments can override national laws they oppose.
Its enforcement priorities can override lawful regional rules.
The legislature prohibited regional agencies from enforcing rules.
Regional rules remain valid despite different enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要某项原本合法的地区规则与该机构的执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称，该机构的执法权高于地区政府所拥有的权限。
exp.structure: claims后面是机构主张的内容；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；outweigh 权重或重要性高于。
exp.meaning: 要区分被描述的主张与文章作者认可的结论。句子是在复述行政机构想要的权力范围，并不代表作者认为这种主张正确。
exp.rest: 地区推翻国家法律反转了主张中的权力方向；立法机关禁止地方执法没有文本依据；机构声称可使规则失效，并非承认优先事项不同时规则仍有效。

partb-boxed-vocab.skill: 转瞬即逝的经历和令人惊叹的事物
partb-boxed-vocab.q: During a fleeting break in the clouds, visitors caught sight of the northern lights, one of the natural marvels they had travelled so far to see. What is the best interpretation?
o: 云层持续整天散开，游客看见了一件日常工具。
云层短暂散开，游客看到了令人惊叹的自然奇观。
游客收到了来自北方的旅行信封。
自然景观在云层散开后永久消失。

exp.trans: 云层短暂散开时，游客看到了北极光——他们远道而来希望见到的自然奇观。
exp.structure: During a fleeting break是时间状语；visitors caught sight of the northern lights为主干；one of the natural marvels是补充说明。
exp.other: catch sight of 看见；northern lights 北极光；travel far 远道而来。
exp.meaning: fleeting表示转瞬即逝的；marvels表示奇观、令人惊叹的事物，不是普通的工具。
exp.rest: 整天晴朗与fleeting冲突；旅行信封并未提及；永久消失不是短暂看见。

partb-boxed-vocab.skill: 科学文化成果的继承者
partb-boxed-vocab.q: The young scientists are inheritors of decades of research on affordable prosthetic limbs. For patients who can finally afford one, the treatment is a dream come true. What does the sentence mean?
o: 科学家继承患者财产后才可开展研究。
科学家放弃了前人的工作，病人的愿望无法实现。
患者继承了科学家的工作职位，但治疗仍是空想。
年轻科学家承接前人成果；患者长期以来的愿望终于实现。

exp.trans: 年轻科学家承接了前人几十年的廉价假肢研究成果；对终于能负担相关治疗的患者来说，愿望成真了。
exp.structure: scientists are inheritors of...为系表结构；后句patients who can finally afford one中who引导定语从句，the treatment is a dream come true为主干。
exp.other: prosthetic limb 假肢；affordable 负担得起的；decades of research 数十年研究。
exp.meaning: inheritor可指继承文化、技术等成果的人或成果的受益者，不限于法律遗产；dream come true表示梦想实现。
exp.rest: 遗嘱、财产和工作职位均不存在于文章；放弃成果与inheritors相反；空想未实现与finally afford相反。

partb-boxed-vocab.q: The aid centre handed out a brown-paper envelope that could also function as a folder for application forms. In this sentence, envelope and function as mean:
o: 牛皮纸信封；还可充当存放申请表的文件夹。
电子邮件；负责审批所有申请。
被包围的区域；监督申请者。
一种打印机；自动向远处发送申请。

exp.trans: 援助中心发放了牛皮纸信封，它还可以当作装申请表的文件夹。
exp.structure: The aid centre handed out a brown-paper envelope为主干；that could also function as a folder是定语从句，修饰envelope。
exp.other: aid centre 援助中心；hand out 分发；application form 申请表。
exp.meaning: envelope为信封，brown-paper envelope为牛皮纸信封；function as表示充当、发挥……的功能。
exp.rest: 电子邮件不同于纸信封；监督区域和打印机功能均与folder无关。

partb-boxed-vocab.q: In the second half of the workshop, the tablet began to function as a camera, a map and a shared notebook for the team. Which interpretation is correct?
o: 工作坊开始前，平板已用于拍照、导航和记笔记。
工作坊结束后，团队用平板播放视频、查邮件和做预算。
工作坊后半段，平板用于拍照、导航和记笔记。
参加工作坊的一半人不会使用相机、地图和笔记功能。

exp.trans: 在工作坊的后半段，这台平板电脑开始同时发挥相机、地图和共享笔记本的功能。
exp.structure: In the second half of the workshop为时间状语；the tablet began to function as为主干；as后有三个并列功能。
exp.other: workshop 工作坊；tablet 平板电脑；shared notebook 共享笔记本。
exp.meaning: the second half of表示某一活动或时代的后半段；function as表示充当、起某种作用，例如function as a typewriter。
exp.rest: in the second half表示活动后半段，不是开始前、结束后或一半参与者；平板的三个功能对应相机、地图和共享笔记本，不是视频、邮件和预算。

partb-boxed-vocab.skill: 动词短语：成功完成困难任务
partb-boxed-vocab.q: The repair crew managed to pull off a temporary bridge installation despite strong winds and missing equipment. What does pull off mean here?
o: Delay an installation until next month
Remove a jacket while working outside
Successfully accomplish a difficult job
Pull a cable away from the bridge

exp.trans: 维修队虽面临强风和设备不足，仍成功完成临时桥梁安装。
exp.structure: managed to pull off的宾语是a temporary bridge installation，表示克服困难完成工作。
exp.other: accomplish完成；installation安装；despite尽管。
exp.meaning: pull off在此是成功做到一件不容易的事，不是实际把某物拉离。
exp.rest: 推迟、脱衣服和拉离电缆都误解了完成任务的语义。

partb-boxed-vocab.target: in a rut / stuck in routine
partb-boxed-vocab.q: After years of repeating the same concert programme, the orchestra felt it was in a rut. Its director suggested inviting new composers. What does in a rut imply?
o: The musicians were travelling on a rough road
The group was trapped in an unchanging routine
The instruments had been damaged during a show
The audience demanded a longer interval

exp.trans: 乐团多年重复同一节目，感觉陷入惯性，指挥建议邀请新作曲家。
exp.structure: After years of repeating和inviting new composers构成停滞与改变的对照。
exp.other: orchestra管弦乐团；routine惯例；composer作曲家。
exp.meaning: in a rut指工作或生活陷入重复、缺乏变化，而不是实物车辙。
exp.rest: 道路颠簸、乐器损坏和延长中场休息都没有证据。

partb-boxed-vocab.q: A historian rejected characterizations of a protest as either entirely peaceful or entirely violent because the records showed several distinct phases. What are characterizations?
o: Descriptions used to portray an event
Official permissions to enter an archive
Payments that funded the demonstration
Rules about how to conduct interviews

exp.trans: 历史学家反对将抗议一概描述为完全和平或完全暴力，因为资料显示多个不同阶段。
exp.structure: rejected characterizations of... 后接as either...or...说明被拒绝的是某些描述方式。
exp.other: characterization描述/概括；phase阶段；portray描绘。
exp.meaning: characterizations在此是对事件特征的表述，并非固定不变的本质。
exp.rest: 档案权限、示威资金和访谈规章均不表示描述或概括。
